judgment.notes: N001 is applied to E in Eucl(n) at q>0 and to F in Eucl(n+1) at a>1 or q+1>0. N002 supplies D>=0 and finite, and its stated singleton conclusion in the n=0 branch. N003 supplies precisely H^a(I)=0. The routine background below has the required local conditions; no measurability is required for arbitrary covering sets.

S001 transfers arbitrarily cheap covers through the distance-preserving parametrization. S002 validly replaces only nonempty zero-diameter members with small positive-diameter balls within a summable budget. S003 covers each vertical interval with ceil(1/r_i) pieces and correctly bounds the product diameters and total cost. S004 gives zero content at every positive scale by arbitrary cost tolerance. S005 uses finite D and arbitrarily small positive excess exponents to obtain the exact bound, including the possibility that dimension was initially extended-valued.

scope: Coverage is reviewer-reported; reading alone is not mathematical assessment.
